scenes.title: Barracuda attack and loss of family
scenes.description: A predator attacks the reef home; Marlin is knocked unconscious and wakes to find his wife and eggs gone, calling desperately for her.

scenes.title: Nemo's fin teasing at school
scenes.description: Other kids comment that Nemo's fin looks funny, and an adult tells them to be nice; a mild moment of a child being singled out for looking different.

scenes.title: Marlin scolds Nemo near open water
scenes.description: Nemo is dared to swim near the dangerous open water by other kids, and his father Marlin swoops in, panics, and embarrasses him in front of them before angrily lecturing him, leading Nemo to say he hates him.

scenes.title: Nemo swims to the boat
scenes.description: Nemo defiantly swims toward a boat despite his father's frantic warnings, ignoring calls to come back.

scenes.title: Nemo captured by divers
scenes.description: Divers scoop Nemo up from the sea as he screams for his father, who desperately tries to reach him but fails.

scenes.title: Marlin searches in despair
scenes.description: Marlin frantically searches the empty water calling for his missing son, panicking and begging other sea creatures for help finding the boat.

scenes.title: Marlin's story moves the sharks
scenes.description: Marlin explains that his son was taken by divers, and the sharks react emotionally, one crying about never knowing his father.

scenes.title: Shark smells blood and turns dangerous
scenes.description: After Dory gets bitten and starts bleeding, the shark Bruce loses control and chases Marlin and Dory, becoming a real threat before they narrowly escape and find themselves trapped with no way out.

scenes.title: Bruce's blood-scented rampage
scenes.description: Bruce the shark smells Marlin's blood and loses control, chasing Marlin and Dory through the sunken submarine, setting off explosive mines as they try to escape.

scenes.title: Nemo calls for his dad
scenes.description: In a brief cut, Nemo is heard calling out for his father, alone and scared.

scenes.title: Nemo taken from bag, meets tank gang
scenes.description: Newly captured Nemo is dropped into an unfamiliar fish tank full of strange creatures, cries in fear and asks where his dad is, wondering if he'll ever get home.

scenes.title: Fish narrate root canal
scenes.description: The tank fish playfully narrate and comment on a human patient's root canal happening off-screen, using dental jargon; it's mostly comic banter rather than a scary scene for the fish characters themselves.

scenes.title: Darla revealed as fish killer
scenes.description: The dentist's niece Darla is shown to have accidentally killed her last pet fish, and Nemo learns he is meant to be her new gift.

scenes.title: Nemo stuck trying to escape
scenes.description: Nemo panics that he cannot get back to his father and gets physically stuck while attempting the escape plan, calling out for help while the other fish debate whether to assist him.

scenes.title: Dory's sleep-talk and mask lost
scenes.description: Dory sleep-talks and briefly screams while things get chaotic, then Marlin loses the mask with the address needed to find Nemo, causing him distress.

scenes.title: Anglerfish attack in the dark
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory are drawn toward a mysterious glowing light, which turns out to be a scary anglerfish; it chases them and they scream and lose sight in the dark before escaping and finding the diver's mask.

scenes.title: Escaping danger, thought dead
scenes.description: Something sudden makes Marlin duck and briefly believe he has died, before realizing he and Dory are safe and celebrating.

scenes.title: Marlin tries to send Dory away
scenes.description: Marlin tells Dory he wants to continue searching for his son alone, and Dory becomes upset and starts to cry, thinking he doesn't like her.

scenes.title: Jellyfish sting encounter
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory encounter a small jellyfish; Dory picks it up like a pet and gets stung, causing a brief scare before Marlin reassures her she'll be fine.

scenes.title: Jellyfish forest game
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory get trapped in a forest of jellyfish and turn escaping into a hopping game, but both get badly stung and Dory collapses unconscious while Marlin desperately tries to keep her awake to remember an address.

scenes.title: Nemo caught in filter machinery
scenes.description: Nemo gets pulled into the tank's filter machinery while trying to clog it, and the other fish frantically try to save him as he struggles and cries for help.

scenes.title: Dentist pulls wrong tooth
scenes.description: A child accidentally pulls a tooth in a startling moment during a dental visit, played for laughs.

scenes.title: Nemo caught in the filter
scenes.description: Nemo swims into the tank's filter mechanism to clog it as part of an escape plan and gets stuck, and his friends scramble to free him before he is hurt; he emerges safe but covered in grime.

scenes.title: Whale approaches, krill swarm
scenes.description: A huge whale appears near Marlin and Dory, and they must swim away quickly to avoid it as krill scatter around them.

scenes.title: Swallowed by the whale
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory find themselves trapped inside a whale's mouth; Marlin panics and despairs while Dory plays and stays calm.

scenes.title: Trapped in the Whale
scenes.description: Marlin and Dory are swallowed inside a giant whale's mouth, panicking as it roars and the water level drops, fearing they will be eaten before the whale releases them.

scenes.title: Escape plan foiled
scenes.description: The Tank Gang wake to find the dentist has installed a new automatic filter, ruining their planned escape from the fish tank.

scenes.title: Nemo's risky escape attempt
scenes.description: As Darla the girl approaches, Nemo tries to escape through the tank machinery and nearly falls or gets hurt, panicking and crying for help before Gill and the others get him to safety.

scenes.title: Pelican startles Marlin
scenes.description: While searching the harbor for the boat, Marlin and Dory are suddenly startled by a large pelican swooping close, and Marlin fears being eaten.

scenes.title: Darla catches Nemo, tank gang's chaotic rescue
scenes.description: Darla the dentist's rough young niece grabs Nemo, who plays dead to survive; the other fish create pandemonium to save him, and he's flushed toward the drain while his father watches, only to be swept away again just as they reunite.

scenes.title: Marlin believes Nemo is dead
scenes.description: Convinced that his son has died, a devastated Marlin says a tearful goodbye to Dory and leaves to go home alone.

scenes.title: Pelicans attack, Dory captured, Nemo calls for Dad
scenes.description: A flock of pelicans swoop in and one snatches Dory in its beak while Nemo desperately calls out for his missing father amid the chaos.

scenes.title: Fish surprised Nemo is alive
scenes.description: A group of fish are shocked to see Nemo alive after believing he had died, then a menacing creature frightens one of them into revealing where Marlin went.

scenes.title: Reunion and net rescue
scenes.description: Marlin and Nemo are joyfully reunited, but then Dory gets caught in a fishing net and Nemo bravely leads a plan to save her by getting all the fish to swim downward together, worrying his father.

scenes.title: Nemo unresponsive after net escape
scenes.description: After breaking free from the fishing net, Nemo is found motionless and unresponsive; his father Marlin frantically searches for him and holds him, fearing he may be dead.
